guitar.evidence: Steve Vai's Ibanez JEM signature series (with the iconic 'monkey grip' and 'Evo' guitar) is one of the most famous signature guitar lines in rock.

tone.target: sustained violin-like lead with liquid high gain and singing mids
tone.profile: sustained violin-like lead with liquid high gain and singing mids
tone.summary: A modern, high-gain signal chain utilizing a Mesa/Recti style amp simulation with boost, chorus, and extensive delay/reverb to achieve sustained, liquid lead tones.

rig.name: Steve Vai - For The Love of God - Valeton GP-180

blocks.purpose: Sustain and lift the signal into the high-gain section.
blocks.gap: Using Boost for controlled gain increase rather than a dedicated EQ boost.

blocks.purpose: Provide high gain saturation without sounding muddy or overly scooped.
blocks.gap: RAT-style is chosen for its aggressive, yet controllable lead tone, mimicking Mesa saturation. Settings are dialed back to avoid excessive grit.

blocks.purpose: Add width and 'liquid' movement to the sustained lead lines.
Simulate the high-gain, saturated tone required for lead playing (Mesa style). Emphasize mids.
blocks.gap: Recti is the best available model for modern, aggressive, mid-focused saturation.

blocks.purpose: Provide a classic, articulate platform for the high-gain tone.
Create the required wide delay and sustain effect.
Add lush, spacious ambience to the sustained lead lines.
blocks.gap: Plate reverb is ideal for adding cinematic sustain without sounding overly metallic.

blocks.purpose: Fine-tune the frequency response to emphasize singing mids and clarity.
blocks.gap: Used as a final tone shaping stage to ensure vocal midrange presence.

improvements.summary: Upgrade IR for better high-gain articulation and midrange focus.

proposals.reason: Improve high-gain articulation and midrange focus for lead tones.
proposals.expectedGain: Increased clarity and presence in the mids.
